text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: difference in mean quantile score over the five decision substations (D5, D10, D11, D14, D16), leads 0.5 to 168 hours, rows outside the switching events, scored year 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026. Line: interval from resampling whole calendar months. Dashed line: no difference. All weather is ECMWF ensemble forecasts.'
text.tspan: Dot: difference in mean quantile score over the five decision substations (D5, D10, D11, D14,
D16), leads 0.5 to 168 hours, rows outside the switching events, scored year 1 July 2025 to 30
June 2026. Line: interval from resampling whole calendar months. Dashed line: no difference.
All weather is ECMWF ensemble forecasts.
